subject: general
question:
a² + b⁴ + c⁶ is logically related to the first diagram as shown below. Following the same logic, find the value that will replace the (?) in the second diagram?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d888447779b7af40728c06dda36fa39e2d04f30cfcf44bd38b5aa58d3c86981.png]
solution:
**The logic followed here is:** Power → (Number of circles × 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ae79105811596d981eac17f1f17def17dde95d5d01173ea4c1203609c85c6b8.png] 

a → (1 circle × 2) ⇒ a2

b → (2 circles × 2) ⇒ b⁴

c → (3 circles × 2) ⇒ c⁶

⇒ a2 + b4 + c6

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eae79695bdf60b2936880824fd74a094000d8ff0ec4328a2372f0153a6b1b80.png] 

2 → (2 circles × 2) ⇒ 24

3 → (3 circles × 2) ⇒ 36

1 → (4 circles × 2) ⇒ 1⁸

⇒ 24 + 36 + 18

⇒ 16 + 729 + 1

⇒746

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
